_comment: Topic lexicons for scripts/build_topic_index.py. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against a variable's question text. They are phrase-led on purpose: a bare word list picks up 'free and fair elections' for fairness, 'overcrowded classrooms' for class and 'poor teaching' for poverty. Every pattern here was written after reading what it matches. Edit and re-run to change what the index counts.

inequality.title: Inequality
inequality.description: Questions about unequal outcomes, unequal treatment and unequal access, across every survey in the archive.

economic-gap.title: Economic gap and redistribution
patterns: gap between the rich and the poor

equality-principle.title: Equality as a principle
patterns: all people have the same rights

excluded_because_they_are_false_friends.fair: free and fair elections, fair count of votes, fair coverage, fair punishment — electoral and judicial fairness, not distributive
excluded_because_they_are_false_friends.poor: poor teaching, poor services, poor condition of facilities — quality, not poverty
excluded_because_they_are_false_friends.region: province or region sampling variables, and regional organisations such as the Arab Maghreb Union
excluded_because_they_are_false_friends.tax: tax compliance and tax authority questions, which are about the state's reach rather than redistribution
excluded_because_they_are_false_friends.living conditions compared: 'your living conditions compared to 12 months ago' is a change over time, not a gap between people; only the relational form is matched
